about: Liberate Hope County from a fanatical doomsday cult led by Joseph Seed and his family in this open world first-person shooter set in the heart of Montana.

Fight against the cult using a massive lethal arsenal or deadly stealth takedowns. From signature melee shovels to heavy rocket launchers, use every tool at your disposal to dismantle Eden’s Gate in bloody combat.

Explore the vast Big Sky Country by land, air, and water. Pilot planes for aerial dogfights, drift through farmlands in iconic muscle cars or ATVs. The world reacts to your every move as you liberate Hope County your way.
